messages:
ana: Heads-up — seeing a sustained pile-up in the eval harness scheduler for the new quant models. Lots of tasks stuck in the queue, high retry churn. Errors look like LeaseAcquireTimeout + OOMs.

chris: Can you paste the logs you saw? rough timestamps are fine.

ana: sure, here's a short snippet from staging (redacted):
```
[2026-03-19T14:02:11Z] worker-17 ERROR LeaseAcquireTimeout shard=23 attempt=1
[2026-03-19T14:02:12Z] scheduler INFO requeue task_id=eval/model-x/rev3 retry=1 reason=lease_timeout
[2026-03-19T14:02:13Z] worker-02 FATAL OOM when allocating tensor batch_size=64 model=model-x
[2026-03-19T14:02:14Z] scheduler WARN backlog_depth=1187 inflight=9 processing_rate=3/s
```

mike: hm, two obvious signals: (1) some workers OOM, which reduces capacity and makes lease waits longer; (2) scheduler keeps re-enqueuing, creating retry amplification. Are we seeing exponential backoff on retries?

nina: autoscaler didn't compensate — pods were CrashLooping so HPA didn't kick. We hit K8s scheduling flaps when nodes got memory pressure.

ana: tried manually scaling workers to 20 but queue still >1k. ingress rate is ~8 tasks/s, processing ~3/s.

chris: short-term mitigation: enable input rate-limiter and cap concurrent leases per-shard to prevent thundering herd. Long-term: make scheduler backoff smarter (add jitter + max_retries) and reduce per-task memory.

ana: proposed patch (staging): reduce per-task batch_size from 64 -> 16; add retry cap=3 with exponential backoff base=1.5s; lease_timeout -> 10s. config snippet: 
```yaml
eval_runner:
  batch_size: 16
  retry:
    max_retries: 3
    backoff_base_s: 1.5
  lease:
    timeout_s: 10
  concurrency:
    max_leases_per_shard: 4
```

eval-bot: CI failed on integration: `tests/integration/test_scheduler_backpressure.py::test_retry_cap` — timeout after 10m. See: https://ci.internal.redwood/12345

mike: CI is flakey because tests use real timing; we should mock time or use synthetic clock. Add a determinism flag to test harness.

nina: i'll push the config change to staging (canary) and add a dashboard panel: `lease_wait_seconds` + `oom_events` + `queued_tasks`. Can we also add alert: queued_tasks > 800 for 5m?

chris: yes add alert. Also add a unit-level simulator test: spawn N workers but throttle processing to simulate backlog; assert scheduler stops requeuing after 3 retries and marks task failed.

ana: assigning actions: @nina push config canary + dashboard alert; @mike add deterministic clock to the CI test and rework test to not rely on real sleeps; @chris open scheduler backoff PR (small) and add unit sim; I'll monitor staging for 60m and post metrics.

nina: ack, starting now.

mike: ack, will take the test work.

chris: ack, will open PR and include simple benchmark showing processing_rate improvement (3/s -> ~6/s) after batch_size drop in a micro-run.

ana: thanks all. please @mention in PRs so I can correlate with staging traces. :thumbsup:
